theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (A B : Set (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (r R C : ℝ) (f : Euclid P → ℝ), Continuous f → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → 0 < r → μHE[n] (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' B ∩ closedBall 0 R) ≠ ∞ → (∀ y : Euclid P, ‖f y‖ ≤ C) → (∀ y : Euclid P, y ∉ closedBall (0 : Euclid P) R → f y = 0) → ‖(∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' B, f y ∂μHE[n]) - ∫ y in Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' A, f y ∂μHE[n]‖ ≤ C * (μHE[n] (Poincare.SimonGMT.Chapter03.blowUpMap x r '' (B \ A) ∩ closedBall 0 R)).toReal
